name: Akemi
source:
Like her son Shuji, she is calm and dependable. She deceives the protagonist with her gentle smile. 

Her boldness is the key to seduction, and she forgets herself when it comes to sex. She takes a liking to the main character Jun.

[From [url=http://milksoht0.x0.com/game12.htm]official site[/url]]
